name: Thermoeye OCTA vessel segmentation baseline
scope: Vessel segmentation only; not AD/MCI classification or diagnosis
runtime_normalization: Pillow L, bilinear resize to 256x256, divide by 255; unsigned 16-bit inputs first use fixed /65535 scaling then quantize to 8-bit
failure_behavior: analysis_status unavailable, engine none and null measurements; never automatic heuristic fallback

measurement_definitions.vessel_density: Vessel pixels / all pixels in the nearest-neighbour resized source-dimension mask * 100
measurement_definitions.faz_risk_proxy: Non-vessel fraction in the central 30% rectangle * 100; not anatomical FAZ area or disease risk
measurement_definitions.perfusion_density: Percent of the 304x304 grid brighter than the FAZ noise floor (FAZ mean + 3 SD); null when no FAZ is found. On the 9 ROSE-O test images it covers 94% of expert-drawn vessels and under 2% of the FAZ. Not comparable with device-reported vessel density.
measurement_definitions.faz_area_mm2: Foveal avascular zone: dark region grown from the darkest central point after a 5x5 box blur (threshold 0.40 x image median) on a 304x304 grid, assuming a 3x3 mm scan. Tuned on 30 ROSE-O train images; 9 held-out test images vs expert FAZ labels: Dice 0.87, mean area error 0.037 mm2, r 0.92.
measurement_definitions.alzheimer_faz_index: Literature-based likelihood ratio (equal prior) of Alzheimer vs control FAZ distributions: control 0.275 +/- 0.10 mm2 (O'Bryhim et al. 2018), Alzheimer shift SMD 0.54 (Frontiers in Aging Neuroscience 2022). Not a trained or validated classifier; no accuracy measured.

runtime_output: sigmoid(logits) thresholded at 0.5; nearest-neighbour resize to source dimensions
note: Artifact exported from the completed checkpoint; independent clinical validation is required.
